name: f90wrap

about.summary: Fortran to Python interface generator with derived type support.
Fortran to Python interface generator with derived type support.

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: f90wrap
  version: "0.3.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 9c9f08768fe7e9d60de9e913e30909fa1bdc67828f49dffd7149089703d74836

build:
  number: 1
  skip: win

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: python
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: numpy
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: meson-python
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: pkg-config
    - setuptools
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler('fortran') }}
  host:
    - python
    - python-build
    - pip
    - numpy
    - meson-python
  run:
    - python
    - numpy
    - packaging

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - f90wrap
      pip_check: true
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pip
    script:
      - f90wrap -h
      - f2py-f90wrap -h

about:
  license: GPL-2.0-or-later
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: Fortran to Python interface generator with derived type support.
  homepage: https://github.com/jameskermode/f90wrap

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jameskermode
    - ocefpaf
    - jan-janssen
